en.headline: Customs seizes 225,000 electronic chips worth HK$6.25 million at Shenzhen Bay
en.dek: Two men were arrested after officers intercepted an outbound private car and found the suspected unmanifested cargo in the boot; they face court today.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected a suspected smuggling case at the Shenzhen Bay Control Point on Tuesday and seized about 225,000 electronic chips with an estimated market value of HK$6.25 million.
Based on risk assessment, officers intercepted an outbound private car. Inspection of the vehicle’s boot revealed the batch of chips, which Customs treated as unmanifested cargo.

A 39-year-old local male driver and a 50-year-old Mainland male passenger were arrested. They were jointly charged with one count of attempting to export unmanifested cargo and are due to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.

Customs said it would continue to combat cross-boundary smuggling through risk assessment and intelligence analysis. Under the Import and Export Ordinance, anyone convicted of importing or exporting unmanifested cargo faces a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關深圳灣檢獲22.5萬枚電子芯片 估值625萬元
zh.dek: 關員截查一輛出境私家車，在車尾箱發現懷疑未列艙單貨物；兩名男子被控意圖輸出未列艙單貨物，今早在屯門裁判法院應訊。
body: 香港海關星期二在深圳灣管制站偵破一宗懷疑走私案，檢獲約22.5萬枚電子芯片，估計市值約625萬元。
關員根據風險評估截查一輛出境私家車，在車尾箱發現該批芯片，並視之為未列艙單貨物。
一名39歲本地男司機及一名50歲內地男乘客被捕，兩人同被控一項意圖輸出未列艙單貨物罪，今日（星期四）在屯門裁判法院應訊。
海關表示會繼續透過風險評估及情報分析打擊跨境走私活動。根據《進出口條例》，任何人輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物，一經定罪最高可被罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
